# 2bid.ai

2bid.ai is a commercial marketplace and licensing layer for data creators and AI data buyers.

Core marketplace paths:
- Creators can publish datasets, prepare metadata, set licensing terms, respond to buyer opportunities, and publish commercial listings.
- Buyers can discover listed datasets or post an AI Data Sourcing Bid describing data they need.
- 2bid.ai provides licence verification for licences issued through 2bid.ai, connecting a submitted copy to licence evidence, the commercial licence record, and source provenance.

Primary public pages:
- https://2bid.ai/
- https://2bid.ai/creator-overview.html
- https://2bid.ai/buyer-overview.html
- https://2bid.ai/verification-overview.html
- https://2bid.ai/register.html
